title: US DSCA Notifies .2 Million Sustainment Package for India's M777 Howitzers & Apaches
summary: Approves foreign military sales package for 145 M777A2 howitzers and 22 AH-64E Apache helicopters.

blocks.content: Approves foreign military sales package for 145 M777A2 howitzers and 22 AH-64E Apache helicopters.

Apache Helicopter Package: .2 million support for 22 AH-64E Apache Guardian helicopters (contractors: Boeing & Lockheed Martin).
